_about: Internal. Hostile unmanned aircraft and scenario roles of the authorised operators. Never give this file to participants.

hostile_uas.what: Pre-storm reconnaissance drone flown from the yacht Narwhal Dream (VSL-0481) at Ingleside Marina Berth 7 (SLIP-ING-07): sorties 1-3 over GW-FAC-SUB-01 (D-11 04:30Z, D-9 06:47Z, D-9/8 04:15Z), sorties 4-5 over the Rendal berth TERM-01 (D-5 05:00Z, D-4/3 04:45Z). 400-600 ft above ground, 900 MHz burst data link, 2.4 GHz command link.
detected_by: CBP aircraft CAMCC-04 (ACF-CBP-001) electronic support measures
Coast Guard radar buoys R-18 and R-22 raw archives (below alert threshold)
hostile_uas.note: Sorties 4 and 5 take place after the yacht's AIS goes dark on D-8; canon gives no launch point for them.

hostile_uas.what: Night overflights of NAS Corpus Christi and the Army depot on six nights between D+1 and D+10 while perimeter sensors are down; operated by STATE-X special forces.
hostile_uas.public: residents' videos D+2; NAS statement D+6; FBI D+9; no sightings after D+11

rules: Hostile drones have no operator record, no FAA registration, no Remote ID and no ICAO address; they never appear in ADS-B or in drone_video.
No drone activity of any kind after D+11. The old D+30 port loiter (UNIDENTIFIED-D30, UNKNOWN-001) is removed.

DRN-OP-001.role: Argus Mk-7 swarm GRID01-GRID08: Phase 1 survey from D+3, Phase 2 utility yards D+8 (images the open breakers at SUB-02 and SUB-03), complete D+45.

DRN-OP-005.role: Two FLIR multirotors pre-staged at Corpus Christi International on D-1; SAR thermal imaging D+1 to D+5.

DRN-OP-001.note: was 'FEMA Region VI UAS Team'; canon operator is the FEMA contractor Argus Aerial Systems (PUB-111)

DRN-OP-004.note: registry listed Texas National Guard small drones; drone_video files used DRN-OP-004 for the real station KIII, now Harborline 6 News (new DRN-OP-004)
